digest.component_or_area: code-review gate criteria routing and blocking threshold
propositions: correctness and edge-cases criteria lack routing entries in criteria_routing.json and resolve through the unknown-criterion default (0.95 non-blocking), despite being two of the largest un-routed dimensions (n=909 and n=618) in the code-v3 corpus

measured block-impact at threshold 0.54 shows correctness would block 51 changes (4.04% of corpus) and edge-cases would block 22 changes (1.74%), both within the 8.0% operator-accepted friction budget
concurrency is routed but advisory (0.95, non-blocking); concurrency at 0.54 would block 0 of 1 surviving finding, below the MIN_N=25 statistical power floor
the hard-coded _BLOCKING_SET literal in replay_code_v4_would_block.py will diverge from the actual applied posture if routing entries are added without updating the script
